task_message:
Case L07: segment the lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on this T1-weighted MRI.

Volume: 206x206x166 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. 

**Summary of the segmentation (case L07, lipomatous soft-tissue tumor, T1-weighted MRI):**
- Identified a large, well-encapsulated hyperintense (fat-signal) intramuscular mass in the anterior compartment of the thigh on axial/coronal/sagittal scouts.
- Seeded the model with two positive points inside the mass (axial slice 83), producing a single connected component following the tumor capsule.
- Verified coverage at multiple levels: proximal/distal ends, coronal and sagittal mid-planes; added a positive point to capture the tapered anterior extension of the lesion at the distal end.
- Reviewed the final multi-planar review (3 slices per plane inside the mask plus one past each end) — no lesion tissue beyond the mask, no stray components.
- Examined all five automatic candidates and rejected them as subcutaneous/intermuscular fat planes rather than tumor tissue.

Final mask: 379.3 mL, 1 connected component, saved with **medium** confidence (uncertainty mainly about the fine fatty extensions at the tumor poles).
